title: Mother & Children at Mission Courtyard, 1968 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken in September 1968 depicting a mother seated with her young son and daughter beside a tiered stone water fountain in a historic Spanish Mission courtyard. In the background wall, arched openings house large historic mission bells above ivy covered stonework. A small wooden sign reads 'PLEASE DO NOT RING BELLS'. The children and mother are casually dressed in typical mid-to-late 1960s summer attire, capturing a candid moment during a family vacation.
